name: GPU-based Fast Ray Casting for Metaballs
definition: A GPU-based ray casting method to render metaballs by directly evaluating the isosurface in a per-pixel manner, avoiding polygonization and expensive precomputation or acceleration structures.
summary: GPU-based Fast Ray Casting for Metaballs renders particle-based implicit surfaces directly on the GPU using Bézier Clipping to solve polynomial equations, avoiding polygonization and grid-based approximations.
